QWEN21_V1_H3_S00_outbound.purpose: Qwen-Image 2.1 现代三维动画画风测试；从清晨空街出发骑向菜市，只验画面与场景连续性。
QWEN21_V1_H3_S00_outbound.qa_summary: 实际首帧与 Qwen 首帧构图一致；192 帧 @24fps。中段机位轻微偏移后回到同一条街道轴线。主角、电瓶车和凌晨环境保持，选 n=191 作为去菜市场镜头切换前的实际末帧。

QWEN21_V1_H3_BR01_market_entry.purpose: 从街道进入现代菜市场，画面明确展示骑车经过入口、左侧可见猪肉摊；检查新画风下场景过渡与人物一致性。

transition_from.cut_reason: 从居民街道切换到有顶菜市场入口；沿用主角、电瓶车和凌晨色温。

QWEN21_V1_H3_BR01_market_entry.qa_summary: 实际开场匹配 Qwen 首帧。107 帧 @24fps。主角骑过市场入口，左侧猪肉摊、红灯和挂肉可见；中后段机位逐渐推近，招牌出现不可读文字，下一镜延用实际 n=106，但画面文字不作剧情信息。

QWEN21_V1_H3_BR02_approach_stop.purpose: 沿 BR01 实际末帧继续，骑到同一左侧猪肉摊前减速并停车；不切镜、不换载具。
QWEN21_V1_H3_BR02_approach_stop.qa_summary: 实际首帧沿用 BR01 n=106。107 帧 @24fps。骑行减速并停在同一左侧摊位前，红灯、吊肉和摊主仍可见；中段机位明显推近，末帧保留停车状态，下一镜从 n=106 接下车动作。

QWEN21_V1_H3_BR03_dismount.purpose: 从 BR02 实际停车末帧继续，闫清熄车、下车并朝柜台迈一步；镜头轻微后退以呈现完整动作。
QWEN21_V1_H3_BR03_dismount.qa_summary: 实际开场沿用 BR02 n=106。107 帧 @24fps；主角完成下车并走向柜台，电瓶车留在摊边、挂肉和红灯仍可见。中后段机位后拉较大并拓宽摊位空间，出现额外摊贩/顾客，末端主角偏向画面左侧；只把 n=106 作为动作与位置交接状态，下一镜有意切到摊位固定双人机位，不沿用其构图。

QWEN21_V1_H3_S01_ask_price.purpose: 闫清已下车并来到同一猪肉摊前；固定双人机位完成问价、听到四十五元一斤并嫌贵。
QWEN21_V1_H3_S01_ask_price.continuity_basis: BR03 actual n=106 documents the protagonist off the scooter and beside the same stall. Because S01 is a planned cut to the fixed counter two-shot, Qwen builds a new frame from the approved identity/environment assets; no prior video frame is claimed as a pixel reference.
QWEN21_V1_H3_S01_ask_price.qa_summary: 实际开场沿用 Qwen 首帧。175 帧 @24fps，固定摊位双人构图，问价/摊主回应/主角嫌贵的表演节拍清楚。中段和末帧保持同一摊主、主角、挂肉、红灯、柜台及后方电瓶车；H3 延续了更明显的三维动画角色造型，未见场景或角色替换。选 n=174 交给验肉镜头。

QWEN21_V1_H3_S02_examine_meat.purpose: 承接问价镜头，摊主介绍黑猪肉；闫清靠近案板并轻按一块肉检查纹理。
QWEN21_V1_H3_S02_examine_meat.qa_summary: 实际开场与 S01 n=174 一致；175 帧 @24fps。中段主角俯身、伸手并按压案板上一块肉，末段收手继续观察，动作节奏清楚。固定摊位机位、人物、挂肉、柜台、红灯及后方电瓶车保持；动画化面部风格持续，未见角色或环境替换。选 n=174 交给手机证据镜头。

QWEN21_V1_H3_S03_phone_evidence.purpose: 闫清问是否早上现杀；老板拿手机展示活猪卡车开进屠宰场的视频；闫清先愣后笑。
QWEN21_V1_H3_S03_phone_evidence.continuity_basis: S02 actual n=174 documents the same two people at the same counter after meat inspection. This is an intentional closer cut to the phone and faces; Qwen uses the approved identity, stall and phone assets rather than claiming pixel inheritance.
QWEN21_V1_H3_S03_phone_evidence.qa_summary: 实际视频 294 帧 @24fps；手机始终由摊主持有，屏幕内持续显示活猪与卡车，画面没有跑出手机；中段主角愣住，末段转为微笑，笑点顺序可读。近景构图、主角与摊主动画脸型保持；红灯和挂肉留在虚化背景内，未见场景替换。选 n=293 交给下单镜头。

QWEN21_V1_H3_S04_order_pack_start.purpose: 手机笑点后切回摊位中景；闫清下五十斤猪肉的单，摊主应下并开始备货。
QWEN21_V1_H3_S04_order_pack_start.continuity_basis: S03 actual n=293 documents the laugh after the phone joke. This is an intentional cut back to the wider fixed counter angle after the phone is put away; same approved identities, stall and scooter are rebuilt from Qwen assets.
QWEN21_V1_H3_S04_order_pack_start.qa_summary: 175 帧 @24fps；下单手势、摊主应下并开始称肉/打包的节拍可读。固定中景保持主角、摊主、电瓶车、吊肉及红灯；画风延续明显的国产三维动画。末帧已有一包肉在秤上、摊主正整理包装，下一镜从这个实际状态递交给主角。

QWEN21_V1_H3_S05_package_handoff.purpose: 承接称肉/打包状态，摊主完成封包并把同一包猪肉递给闫清。
QWEN21_V1_H3_S05_package_handoff.qa_summary: 107 帧 @24fps；摊主收好秤上同一包肉，主角双手接过，末帧肉包在主角手中，手部交接清楚。人物、摊位、挂肉、红灯和电瓶车均保留，动画风格稳定。下一个镜头切到车旁装货位置；该包肉会作为唯一交接物继续，并按五十斤订单在装车构图中呈现合理体量。

QWEN21_V1_H3_BR04_load_pork.purpose: 切到车旁，闫清把唯一一包五十斤猪肉放上同一辆电瓶车后架并固定。
QWEN21_V1_H3_BR04_load_pork.continuity_basis: S05 actual n=106 shows the received parcel in Yan Qing's hands. This is a planned cut from the counter to the nearby parked scooter; Qwen re-composes the same single parcel and protagonist beside the same market stall.
QWEN21_V1_H3_BR04_load_pork.qa_summary: 实际视频抽查 n=0/53/106：唯一肉包从主角手中落到后架并固定，末帧主角已松手检查；没有重复肉包，车、人物和左侧挂肉猪肉摊保持在同一构图。选真实 n=106 交接。

QWEN21_V1_H3_BR05_market_exit.purpose: 从车旁连续拍闫清上车，带唯一肉包骑出猪肉摊所在菜市场入口。
QWEN21_V1_H3_BR05_market_exit.continuity_basis: 继承 BR04 实际 n=106：同一辆停稳的蓝灰电瓶车上固定唯一肉包，闫清在车旁检查完毕。
QWEN21_V1_H3_BR05_market_exit.qa_summary: 实际视频 n=0/53/106 通过：唯一肉包全程留在同一后架，人物自然上车并沿菜市场通道驶向出口，左侧摊位挂肉在前段可见；n=106 到达市场外沿，作为回家地点切换的真实状态参考。末段 H3 自行补出一辆路过白车，作为轻微背景瑕疵记录。

QWEN21_V1_H3_S01_return_home.purpose: 切回现代凌晨街道，闫清带同一肉包骑车回家，完成买肉故事的回程。
QWEN21_V1_H3_S01_return_home.continuity_basis: BR05 实际 n=106 是市场出口处带肉离开；返家属于明确地点切换。Qwen 只重构街道机位，保留同一主角、车辆與后架唯一肉包。
QWEN21_V1_H3_S01_return_home.qa_summary: 实际视频 n=0/53/106 通过：同一闫清、蓝灰电瓶车与唯一白色肉包保持一致，沿住宅街道持续向远处骑行；画面无市场或古装元素，街景和光线连续。抽查到 n=106，作为本片终点。

V2_CODEX_EP02SC01_S02_h3.purpose: 在 S01 单镜画面检查后，以实际末帧为连续性锚点，生成 B2 黑猪肉介绍与闫清验肉动作；忽略声音，只检查画面、场景和人物一致性。

V2_CODEX_EP02SC01_S03_h3.purpose: B3 一镜到底：摊主举手机证明新鲜，屏幕中的活猪卡车驶入场地，闫清先愣后笑；保留原剧本对白与旁白，视觉只做这一个连续动作。
V2_CODEX_EP02SC01_S03_h3.qa_summary: 人物身份、手机道具、猪肉托盘和摊位在片内稳定；闫清完成先愣后笑。摊主后半段被模型带出明显笑容，与剧本‘认真证明’不符，因此保留此版并针对摊主保持中性表情再生成一个比较版。

V2_CODEX_EP02SC01_S03_v3_h3.purpose: B3 单镜修正版：匹配原戏，只呈现闫清反应、手机屏幕和摊主带疤手臂，摊主脸不入镜；保持一镜到底与同一摊位。

V2_CODEX_EP02SC01_S04A_h3.purpose: B4 order and wrapping action, as one fixed-camera H3 shot; review visuals only, not audio.
V2_CODEX_EP02SC01_S04A_h3.qa_summary: 175 frames at 24fps (7.29s), 1376x768. Five sampled frames keep both faces, wardrobe, counter, door, hanging meat, sausages, and screen sides stable. The butcher completes one paper parcel; no bike appears; parcel remains on counter at actual n=174. H3 opening composition closely follows the new keyframe. Four red pendant lamps are visible in this crop; shot-to-shot stall continuity is acceptable for a new medium-wide camera cut. Selected as the S04B continuity source; audio ignored.

V2_CODEX_EP02SC01_S04B_h3.purpose: B4 transfer and loading action: receive the same wrapped pork parcel and strap it on the approved e-bike rear rack; visual review only.
V2_CODEX_EP02SC01_S04B_h3.qa_summary: 175 frames at 24fps (7.29s), 1376x768. Five sampled frames preserve the stall, screen direction, faces and one wrapped parcel. Yan Qing receives the parcel, moves to the approved e-bike, places it on the rear rack and secures it with one plain strap; the bicycle stays still through the final frame. Selected as the exact same-camera handoff into the departure shot; audio ignored.

V2_CODEX_EP02SC01_S04C_h3.purpose: B4 departure: continue directly from S04B actual tail; mount the loaded e-bike and ride out through the market aisle.
V2_CODEX_EP02SC01_S04C_h3.qa_summary: 175 frames at 24fps (7.29s), 1376x768. Actual opening frame inherits S04B n=174 and preserves the same camera/stall geometry. The rider mounts and rides down the aisle; butcher remains at the stall. The single wrapped parcel remains on the rear seat/rack through the sampled frames and the rider recedes without turning back. Selected as the continuity source for the outdoor ride-home cut; audio ignored.

V2_CODEX_EP02SC02_S01_return_home_h3.purpose: 新增返家镜头：闫清骑同一辆载有一包肉的电动车沿 SCN-02 街道回家；只评估画面、角色与场景一致性。
V2_CODEX_EP02SC02_S01_return_home_h3.qa_summary: Selected output trims raw frames 0-63, which form an unplanned close side pass/reframe and briefly add a front basket. Five samples from raw n=64,92,119,146,174 preserve the same dawn street geometry, rider seen from behind, one tan parcel on the rack, and uninterrupted forward travel. Identity face is not judgeable in the selected rear view; no visual drift detected in the sampled frames. The original 175-frame H3 render remains preserved for comparison; final assembly must use selected_video_output and must not insert the separate keyframe before H3 n=0.
